Type: dresser
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rylee Modern Acacia Wood 6-Drawer Bedroom Dresser, 61"W, Gray-Wash Acacia
Colors: Beige
Materials: stone
Add a modern flair to your home with this beautiful dresser. Made from solid acacia with a subtle gray-wash finish, this dresser perfectly complements most home-décor styles. Its 4 elegant but strong legs keep the dresser sturdy, and its 6 drawers provide plenty of storage options. 61"W x 17.7"D x 31.5"H Subtle gray-washed distressed finish and clean lines create an attractive modern look. This dresser has 6 soft-closing drawers. No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Solid acacia with acacia veneer on back panel, shelves, and drawer bottoms
